# Minced meat sauce

Type: Food | Internal ID: MinceMeatSauce | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Boar meat x1, Neck tail x1, Carrot x1 | Max Health: 40 | Max Stamina: 13 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Minced meat sauce is a Black Forest-tier food.

## Recipe

Minced meat sauce is produced in a level 1 Cauldron with:
• 1 Boar meat
• 1 Carrot
• 1 Neck tail

## Notes

• Minced meat sauce provides the second highest health gain in the Black Forest at 40, second to Deer stew at 45.
